test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All planks are woods.

Some woods are glasses

**Conclusions:**

I. Some planks are glasses.

II. All planks are glasses.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
**Statements:**

All planks are woods.

Some woods are glasses.

**Possible Venn diagram:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86fb8390d1e18195728fbaeabd97ced537fd69d6e1c3d1a3ff5f3e7f961f0c3f.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some planks are glasses →** Does not follow → **(As all planks are woods and some glasses are woods so, some planks are glasses is possibility but not definite true)

II. All planks are glasses →** Does not follow →** (As all planks are woods and some glasses are woods so all planks are glasses is a possibility but not definite true.)

**Neither conclusion I nor II follows**.

Hence,** 'option 1'** is the correct answer.
